help_text:
🐾 Welcome to the game! 🐾

This Web3 gaming framework allows you to support Gery, the mountain cat.

🎯 How does it work?
1. Click on the I support Gery, the mountain cat button
2. Enter your code
3. Choose games
4. Collect as many points as possible
5. You can finish the games by clicking on the ⬆.
📌 Every game has a different multiplier! 📌

At the end of the month, the top player will be promoted in the Gery ranking system!
The competition starts again at the beginning of the month.

🐱 Have fun! 🐱
